newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAISIO TO ASSESS BENECOL EXPORTS IN 1997.
newsitem.headline: RAISIO TO ASSESS BENECOL EXPORTS IN 1997.

text.p: Raision Tehtaat Oy, the Finnish group which has developed a unique cholesterol-reducing margarine, said on Tuesday it expects to be able to examine export markets for the product next year.
"We will certainly be able to look at the export markets next year," investor relations manager Sten von Hellens told Reuters Financial Television in an interview.
He declined any comment on whether Raisio would announce a partnership for international distribution of the margarine at presentations to be held in London and Helsinki next Thursday.
"We have promised to tell about (advances) in the Benecol business and I think we will have quite an interested audience," he said.
Asked to comment on Raisio's January-August results, published earlier on Tuesday, von Hellens said the outlook for the third tertial now looks better after a weak start.
"We've been able to pick up quite a lot ... during the second tertial and the outlook for the remaining tertial ... looks better now," he said.

On the overall profit outlook, he said: "We will reach the same level as last year," which he subsequently clarified to Reuters referred to a rough figure and did not mean any significant change from Raisio's published outlook.
In its results statement, Raisio said it expected full-year profit "just slightly short of that for 1995".
